entities.name: The Brokers
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna, a demonic law firm centered in white that fronts racketeering with contract magic.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane of the five crime families and the Halo.

entities.name: Old Capenna
entities.description: The earlier era of the plane, when the Brokers served as protectors and paladins.

entities.name: Falco Spara
entities.description: A demon-aven who leads the Brokers and originated their contract-weaving abilities.

entities.name: Nido Sanctuary
entities.description: The Brokers' headquarters, a lavish office in the central district of the Mezzio.

entities.name: The Mezzio
entities.description: The central district of New Capenna.

entities.name: The Caldaia
entities.description: A district of New Capenna where Riveteers might accost people.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: A district of New Capenna where Maestros' assassins may corner people.

entities.name: The Riveteers
entities.description: A crime family whose brass-knuckle-toting gangs accost people in the Caldaia.

entities.name: The Maestros
entities.description: A crime family whose assassins corner people in Park Heights.

entities.name: The Obscura
entities.description: A crime family that shares the counters archetype with the Brokers.

entities.name: The New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Brokers led Capenna's defense.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose massacre targeted Falco.

entities.name: The Halo
entities.description: The substance Capenna depends on; the Brokers believe it drying up will doom the city.

entities.name: Kros
entities.description: A leonin enforcer of the Brokers.

entities.name: Lagrella the Magpie
entities.description: A human lieutenant of the Brokers.

entities.name: Perrie
entities.description: A rhox enforcer of the Brokers.

entities.name: Rigo
entities.description: A young leonin of the Brokers.

entities.name: Denry Klin
entities.description: A leonin editor in chief associated with the Brokers.

events.summary: During Old Capenna, the Brokers travel from village to village making pacts of protection; after the city's founding this evolves into protection rackets.
events.quote: After the city was founded, these duties evolved into protection rackets.

events.summary: The Brokers lead the defense of Capenna during the New Phyrexian Invasion; Falco is a crucial target of Atraxa's massacre.
events.quote: The Brokers led the defense of Capenna during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: Falco is the boss of the family.
relations.quote: The Brokers are led by the demon - aven Falco Spara
The Brokers' headquarters is Nido Sanctuary

relations.note: The Brokers intercede against Riveteer gangs on behalf of clients.
